milestone.title: fixture/scenario hygiene — drop orphan brownfield-api, fix stale p3.1 scenario note, index code-review lessons

intent.outcome: Test fixtures ship only what tests load, scenario notes describe what the scenario actually proves, and the code-review lessons catalog has a sorted ID index plus a test that keeps IDs unique and the index complete — without renumbering any lesson.

problem.description: Three fixture drifts (verified 2026-09-27): (a) tests/fixtures/projects/brownfield-api/ contains only master-plan/specs/api.json — no plan, not listed in `make test-fixtures`, and loaded by no test; it cannot be validated as-is. (b) tests/scenarios/p3.1-hybrid-work-next-track/scenario.json passes today (phase: implemented; scenarios_runner 14/14 green) and the hybrid-work fixture has .mp/sessions/, but its notes field still says 'Session milestone under sessions/ is not in Rust path yet', which misleads readers. (c) crates/mp/tests/fixtures/code-review-lessons.md groups lessons thematically, so `### L<n>.` headings are out of numeric order (L47 sits between L11 and L12, L26/L48/L39-L41 inside the L14-L15 gap, etc.). Renumbering is NOT an option: 41+ references in code_review_patterns.rs, the mp-code-review skill, CHANGELOG, and completed milestones key on the current IDs. Readers need a numeric index instead.

in_scope: Rewrite the notes field of tests/scenarios/p3.1-hybrid-work-next-track/scenario.json to describe what it asserts (next.prefer=track surfaces BF-02 ahead of session milestones); phase stays implemented.

Add a numeric index (ID → title, ascending) near the top of crates/mp/tests/fixtures/code-review-lessons.md plus a one-paragraph header explaining the file's dual role (runnable-pattern fixture for crates/mp/tests/code_review_patterns.rs; lesson syllabus for the repo-internal mp-code-review skill).

Add tests in crates/mp/tests/code_review_patterns.rs: lessons_ids_are_unique, lessons_index_is_complete_and_sorted (index lists every `### L<n>.` heading exactly once, ascending), lessons_header_states_dual_role.
out_of_scope: Renumbering or physically reordering lessons (IDs are referenced externally).
Rewriting the contents of individual lessons.
Moving the lessons file (code_review_patterns.rs loads it from crates/mp/tests/fixtures/, and docs/ is a scanned consumer surface).
Editing completed milestone M28's evidence — history stays as recorded.

acceptance_criteria.description: tests/fixtures/projects/brownfield-api is gone and nothing in the repo references it.
acceptance_criteria.verification: test ! -e tests/fixtures/projects/brownfield-api && ! rg -q 'brownfield-api' crates tests scripts Makefile docs
